title: Father & Sons in White Suits, Brick Porch - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A proud father dressed in a tailored mid-century suit and geometric-patterned tie stands with his arms around his two young sons on the sidewalk in front of their home's brick porch steps. Both boys are dressed in all-white suits and white dress shoes, typical attire for a Catholic First Communion, Confirmation, or festive Easter Sunday in post-World War II America. The print features classic deckle-edged borders.
